text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A republican decree was issued to set up an authority for investment and free zones. Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri issued the executive rules of the recently-passed investment law.
- The State Security Bureau of Investigation uncovered a Moslem Brotherhood group in Alexandria and arrested its members. The new group aimed to penetrate student circles.
- A power grid between Libya and Egypt to be operative by the end of this year.
- Water level of Lake Nasser increased four centimetres to 178.78 metres.
- A new industrial city is to be set up in the province of Matrouh. The city will create 16,000 new jobs.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak to meet today with university presidents.
- The stock exchange all-share index rose to 335.23 points at the end of the last week after several weeks of decline.
- Mubarak discusses Arab affairs with Emir of Bahrain Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa.
- Another member of parliament died in the province of Fayoum.
